verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL is documented as running directly on the data lake with ANSI SQL plus Delta Lake extensions, without moving data. That covers querying Delta in place. However, the pack never mentions Iceberg, and gives no documented direct querying of raw Parquet files in object storage. missing for 10: explicit Iceberg table support, documented in-place querying of Parquet/files in object storage, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can query open table formats and files in object storage — Iceberg, Delta, Parquet — without first loading them into proprietary storage

citations.quote: It runs directly on your data lake, supports ANSI SQL with Delta Lake extensions, and provides the tools to build highly performant, cost-effective data warehouses without moving your data.
